Fetch every top-level item in a Zotero library as CSL-JSON

Source: R/read.R
cz_fetch_items.Rd

Uses the /items/top endpoint (excludes notes, attachments and other child items) and pages through the whole library using the Total-Results header. After the first page, the remaining pages are requested in parallel (at most getOption("citezot.max_active", 4) at a time, and throttled) and the library version is checked so that a library edited mid-download is re-fetched rather than returned inconsistent.

Usage

cz_fetch_items(
  auth = cz_auth(),
  page_size = 100,
  cache = getOption("citezot.cache", FALSE),
  refresh = FALSE
)

Arguments

auth

Credentials from cz_auth().

page_size

Items per request (Zotero's maximum is 100).

cache

Use and update the local cache? Defaults to getOption("citezot.cache", FALSE).

refresh

If TRUE, ignore any existing cache and download the whole library (the cache, if enabled, is then rewritten).

Value

A list of CSL-JSON items (plain lists, simplifyVector = FALSE). The order is not guaranteed.

Details

A full download of a large library takes a while. With cache = TRUE the items are stored in a local file (in tools::R_user_dir("citezot", "cache"), or getOption("citezot.cache_dir")), and later calls download only what changed since: one request if nothing changed, otherwise the changed items plus the lists of deleted and trashed items. The cache holds the library's bibliographic metadata, never your API key. It is opt-in: nothing is written to disk unless you ask, either here or with options(citezot.cache = TRUE). Use refresh = TRUE to ignore the cache and download everything again, and cz_clear_cache() to delete it.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
items <- cz_fetch_items()
length(items)

# Keep a local copy, so later calls download only what changed
items <- cz_fetch_items(cache = TRUE)
} # }
